items.title: NHS programme transforming skin cancer diagnosis in Cheshire and Merseyside shortlisted for national awards
items.summary: Birkenhead News (seen via Google Alert, 03/09/2026): a Cheshire and Merseyside Integrated Care Board programme to transform skin cancer diagnosis has been shortlisted for national awards.

items.title: Migraine and acne amid conditions added to Pharmacy First scheme
items.summary: Five new areas have been added to the Pharmacy First scheme, with eligible pharmacies now able to prescribe medications for acne and migraine.
